reserveReview.rationale: Fresh live re-read on 2026-08-23. At Rootstock block 9,176,862 (hash 0x3d87d43209d3c8be7112d65533f14c6dcd3cc9b60ef56e3299e041dd197207cd; 2026-08-23 17:30:36 UTC), eth_getBalance for MoC proxy 0xf773B590aF754D597770937Fa8ea7AbDf2668370 returned 282.460500975219498625 rBTC, and eth_call totalSupply() (selector 0x18160ddd) on DOC 0xE700691Da7b9851F2F35f8b8182C69C53ccad9DB returned 3,126,808.182966185929591714 DOC. The Money On Chain docs read today state: "DOC can only be minted in exchange for RBTC" and MoC "is also the only one that receives RBTC and holds the actual value of the system." The current balance and protocol design support the unchanged 100% rBTC slice; no fiat, Treasury, stablecoin, or other reserve category is asserted.

reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No reserve asset class is unclassified; the current MoC balance and DOC total supply were read directly on Rootstock, and the official protocol documentation describes no off-chain reserve component.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: All collateral sits in the single MoC system contract, an upgradeable proxy, so contract-admin action is the operative custody risk rather than a custodian. The 2026-08-23 Rootstock read confirms the current balance at the MoC address; no legal segregation, bankruptcy-remoteness, or rehypothecation terms exist for contract custody. Public code audits in the official repository date to 2019.
